agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
July 13, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Councilmember Steve De Ruse
3.

4.
ROLL CALL
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF MEG KALUGIN FOR HER DEDICATED SERVICE TO THE COMMUNITY - It is recommended the City Council present Meg Kalugin with a plaque in recognition of her service to the La Mirada community.
5.1 Recognition of Meg Kalugin
5.2
PROCLAMATION FOR PARKS AND RECREATION MONTH - It is recommended the City Council proclaim July 2021 as Parks and Recreation Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Community Services Director Oliver Osuna.
5.2 Proclamation for Parks and Recreation Month
5.3
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE – It is recommended the City Council recognize Jose Amaya for his years of service and present him with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
5.3 Recognition of City Employee
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of June 22, 2021.
7.1 Minutes of June 22, 2021 Council Meeting
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated July 13, 2021 in the total amount of $6,972,469.17.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
APPROVAL OF THE FRIENDS OF THE LA MIRADA LIBRARY BOOK SALE FUNDRAISING EVENT IN THE LA MIRADA ACTIVITY CENTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the request for the use of the La Mirada Activity Center from the Friends of the La Mirada Library for the fall book sale fundraiser event.
7.3 Request from Friends of the Library
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-02, REPLACE THE EXISTING MARQUEE DISPLAY AT THE LA MIRADA THEATRE – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-02, Replace the Existing Marquee Display at the La Mirada Theatre, to National Sign & Marketing Corporation in the amount of $155,072; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed ten percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost.
7.4 CIP No. 2021-02
7.5
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH INTEGRATED SOLUTIONS TO PREPARE THE CITY’S LOCAL HAZARD MITIGATION PLAN - It is recommended the City Council approve a professional services agreement with Integrated Solutions for the development of a Local Hazard Mitigation Plan pursuant to the terms of the Agreement and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
7.5 Agreement for LHMP
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 717 AMENDING THE ZONING CODE, TITLE 21 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE AND THE IMPERIAL HIGHWAY SPECIFIC PLAN (IHSP) AS FOLLOWS: AMEND SUBSECTION 21.62.075(a) OF CHAPTER 21.62, ELECTRIFIED FENCE STANDARDS; AMEND TABLE 21.68.050, OF CHAPTER 21.68, PARKING AND LOADING; AMEND TABLE 21.76.070, OF CHAPTER 21.76, SIGNS; AMEND TABLE 6-4, OFF-STREET PARKING REQUIREMENTS, OF THE IHSP; AND AMEND SECTION 6.9, SIGNS, OF THE IHSP – It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 717 amending Subsection 21.062.075(a), of Chapter 21.62, Electrified Fence Standards, of Title 21; Table 21.68.050, of Chapter 21.68, Parking and Loading, of Title 21; Table 21.76.070, of Chapter 21.76, Signs, of Title 21; Table 6-4, Off-Street Parking Requirements, of the IHSP; and Section 6.9, Signs, of the IHSP, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.1 Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance No. 717
CITY COUNCIL
